name: UX Orionis
summary: UX Orionis is a young star with irregular brightness changes caused mainly by circumstellar dust obscuring the star.
why_interesting: Its irregular dimming events help astronomers study the structure and dynamics of its circumstellar disk.

facts.label: Distance
facts.compare: The light you see left it about 1,500 years ago (460 parsecs, the distance adopted in the 2016 study).

facts.label: Mass
facts.compare: More than twice the mass of the Sun

facts.label: Size
facts.compare: About 2.7 times the radius of the Sun.

facts.label: Age
facts.source: Kreplin et al. (2016), citing earlier studies

papers.title: Resolving the inner disk of UX Orionis
